01: He will stay on earth forty days. One day like a year. One day like a month. One day like a week.
02: A day like a year? How is that even possible?!
03: One explanation, from a great scholar of the last century, is hidden on our own planet.
04: Near the North Pole, one day and one night last a whole year. Further south... a month. Then a week. Then normal days.
05: So it starts in the far north... and spreads to the whole world?
06: In the last century, from the cold north, a war against faith spread across many lands. Mosques were closed, and people learned their religion in secret.
07: He will move like a cloud driven by the wind, and there will be no town he does not enter, except Makkah and Madinah.
08: Every town in forty days? On camels, that's impossible!
09: On camels, yes. But today, one idea can reach every phone on earth in seconds.
10: With him will be a garden and a fire. But his fire is a garden, and his garden is fire.
11: Then why didn't the Prophet, peace be upon him, just tell us his name, and the date?
12: So that every generation stays awake, and asks: could this be our time? And Allah knows best.
13: And the protection never changes: the first ten ayat of the Surah of the Cave.
